Dear [Mr Holgate](../persons.html#1643)[^1]
I will try what I can do. I did write a short [memoir](../books.html#66) of Lord Seaton in the Christian Remembrancer, and it has all the dates.

If I can find it, I can easily do what you wish.

How soon will it be wanted?

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Clifford Wyndham Holgate (1859-1903) was the author of a number of works on the history of Winchester College; this correspondence seems to relate to a proposed article on Lord Seaton, perhaps to be published in the school magazine?
